root: ^Faulty Knight: After many a war in my day, and more than a few torn knees, I at last laid down my sword and took up the quill.
^ ‘Tis for the best. Nothing brings me greater joy than to hear children laugh at my tales—stories of chasing ogres while slipping upon cabbages.
^Do you have any tales from your time?

c-0: ^Faulty Knight: My true name? Sir Alec. Yet folk remember me for my follies—unsharpened blades, mounting the wrong steed, armour full of holes,
^ shields that shattered at the direst hour. The list is long indeed.
^Faulty Knight: Yet, through all, fortune clung to me as a shadow. I survived battles from which none thought I’d return.
^ Thus was I named the Faulty Knight—renowned not for skill, but for stumbling into victory.
^Faulty Knight: It’s not to say I lacked prowess with the blade. Truth be told, I often tangled myself in details—
^ too eager, too stubborn, ever following my heart before my head.
^ Yet I toppled cruel lords, outwitted war generals, saved villages from ruin, and earned a hero’s welcome more than once.
^Faulty Knight: What I cherish most, though, are the foes I spared. Bandits, mercenaries, even war captains—I offered them mercy, and many took it.
^ Some still send letters, and read my books to their children by candlelight. Imagine that: bedtime tales from the knight who once chased them through the mire.

s0: ^Faulty Knight: Once, a war general pursued me through the pines. My cloak caught upon a branch, I spun, he stumbled, and over the cliff he went. My men swore it a cunning ambush. I never told them otherwise.
s1: ^Faulty Knight: Once, I forgot to draw my sword against a slime. Turns out, a good pommel-thump fares better than slicing jelly in two.
s2: ^Faulty Knight: I confess, I slew a dragon by poisoning it with arrows. A shame? No. It was never going to be a fair fight.
s3: ^Faulty Knight: I once woke in a gaol cell, with no memory how I came there—turns out, I’d kissed a prince’s betrothed at the royal feast. Hard to explain, but the court wizard’s spells proved my mind was muddled from a blow to the head.

s0: ^Faulty Knight: Always carry resin for your blade. A minute’s fire on steel may spare you an hour’s bleeding in the mud.
s1: ^Faulty Knight: Always bear antidotes. Spiders never ask if you are ready before they bite.
s2: ^Faulty Knight: Hunting hides? Wolves and boars suffice. As for dragons—if you are close enough to skin one, your troubles are greater than tailoring.

s0: ^Faulty Knight: I nearly came to blows with General Alcino once. Even a lucky war hero knows better than to cross a demon prince.
s1: ^Faulty Knight: King Merlot recruits freely these days. Say you are eager to join and do ten pushups without fainting—you’re in.
s2: ^Faulty Knight: My healer forbade me mead. I’ve taken to carrot juice instead. Strange thing is… I think I’m beginning to enjoy it.
